commit.message:
Add comprehensive load and performance testing documentation and scripts for PinCEX

- Created LOAD_TEST_README.md detailing test scenarios, tools, setup instructions, metrics, and reporting.
- Developed PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md to summarize testing methodology, infrastructure, results, and recommendations.
- Implemented Locust scripts for sustained and spike load testing (locust_sustained.py, locust_spike.py).
- Added k6 scripts for sustained (sustained_100k_tps.js) and spike (spike_150k_tps.js) load testing.
- Generated sample result files for Locust sustained tests, including exceptions, failures, stats, and history.
